name: Extra-Dimensional Book Repository
description: A small door on the chest of the creature opens into an extra‑dimensional bookcase. This bookcase functions exactly as a bag of holding except that it can store only written materials such as books, scrolls, tomes, parchment, folders, notebooks, spellbooks, and the like.
